conceptual_change: Introduce a look-back buffer in the trading engine to enforce the 0.1% price deviation threshold over a 3-candle moving window before triggering execution, rather than evaluating the threshold on the latest candle alone.
rationale: The parent BC identified that a state machine is required to handle execution logic; this hypothesis refines the state machine logic by adding a temporal buffer to confirm the 0.1% deviation, reducing false signals from momentary volatility.
